sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是萨布丽娜·塔韦尼西，这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: The Southern Baptist Convention, the largest Protestant denomination in the country, voted at its annual gathering last week to condemn IVF fertility treatments.
sentences.zh: 美南浸信会是该国最大的新教教派，在上周的年度集会上投票谴责了试管婴儿生育治疗。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague, Ruth Graham, on the story behind the vote, the Republicans' scramble it prompted, and what it could eventually mean for the rest of the country.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事露丝·格雷厄姆将为您讲述这项投票背后的故事、它引发的共和党人的争抢，以及它对全国其他地区可能产生的深远影响。

sentences.en: It's Monday, June 17th.
sentences.zh: 今天是6月17日，星期一。

sentences.en: So Ruth, you write about religion for The Times and you were covering the big annual meeting of Southern Baptists last week.
sentences.zh: 那么露丝，你为《时报》撰写宗教报道，你上周报道了美南浸信会盛大的年度会议。

sentences.en: And they made a pretty big decision.
sentences.zh: 他们做出一个相当重大的决定。

sentences.en: Tell us about it.
sentences.zh: 给我们讲讲吧。

sentences.en: The Southern Baptist Convention, it's the biggest Protestant denomination in the United
sentences.zh: 美南浸信会，它是美国最大的

sentences.en: States.
sentences.zh: 新教教派。

sentences.en: They have almost 13 million members, more than 45,000 churches.
sentences.zh: 他们拥有近1300万名成员，超过45,000座教堂。

sentences.en: It's a huge group.
sentences.zh: 这是一个庞大的群体。

sentences.en: And Southern Baptists know their political power and they are basically a barometer of evangelical sentiment in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 美南浸信会深知自身的政治影响力，他们基本上就是美国福音派情绪的晴雨表。

sentences.en: You know, what they say kind of indicates what the typical evangelical cares about in any moment.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们的言论在某种程度上反映了典型福音派在任何时刻所关心的事情。

sentences.en: And fun for reporters, they all meet once a year in this giant gathering that any church can send delegates to.
sentences.zh: 对记者来说有趣的是，他们每年都会聚在一起举行一次大型集会，任何教堂都可以派代表参加。

sentences.en: The delegates are called messengers.
sentences.zh: 这些代表被称为信使。

sentences.en: So this year, that meeting was in Indianapolis.
sentences.zh: 所以今年，会议在印第安纳波利斯举行。

sentences.en: There were almost 11,000 messengers there in the convention center.
sentences.zh: 会议中心有近11,000名信使。

sentences.en: And one of the important political topics they took on this year was something they have never discussed as a full body before, and that's the ethics of in vitro fertilization.
sentences.zh: 今年他们探讨的一个重要政治话题，是他们以前从未以整个团体的名义讨论过的事情，那就是体外受精的伦理问题。

sentences.en: Okay, so this very important conference of Southern Baptists takes up IVF.
sentences.zh: 好的，这个非常重要的美南浸信会会议开始讨论试管婴儿。

sentences.en: In other words, you know, the medical procedure that allows people to get pregnant through fertilization in a lab.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，也就是通过实验室受精让人怀孕的医疗程序。

sentences.en: So what do they say?
sentences.zh: 那么他们是怎么说的？

sentences.en: So a lot of Southern Baptists historically have not taken issue with IVF per se at all.
sentences.zh: 从历史上看，许多美南浸信会信徒本身并不对试管婴儿本身持有异议。

sentences.en: They view it as a technology used to create life.
sentences.zh: 他们认为这是一项用来创造生命的科技。

sentences.en: You know, it's used by families who desperately want to be parents.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这是那些极度渴望成为父母的家庭所使用的。

sentences.en: And they view that as a positive thing.
sentences.zh: 他们认为这是一件积极的事情。

sentences.en: But the procedure does involve typically the production of more embryos than will be used by the couple that created them.
sentences.zh: 但这个程序通常涉及产生的胚胎数量，会超过创造它们的夫妇实际使用的数量。

sentences.en: And those embryos end up sometimes discarded, sometimes frozen indefinitely, sometimes donated, but not sort of used in the way that they were originally created to be used.
sentences.zh: 而这些胚胎最终有时会被丢弃，有时会被无限期冷冻，有时会被捐赠，但并没有按照它们最初被创造出来的初衷去使用。

sentences.en: So some Southern Baptists do take issue with discarding those excess embryos.
sentences.zh: 因此，一些美南浸信会信徒确实对丢弃这些多余的胚胎提出了异议。

sentences.en: And the reason is they say life begins at conception.
sentences.zh: 原因在于他们认为生命始于受精。

sentences.en: This is sort of a core anti-abortion belief.
sentences.zh: 这是核心的反堕胎信仰之一。

sentences.en: The moment that the sperm meets the egg, that is the stuff of life.
sentences.zh: 精子与卵子相遇的那一刻，就是生命的本质。

sentences.en: There's a verse in Psalms, You created my inmost being.
sentences.zh: 《诗篇》中有一节经文：你造了我肺腑之内的主体。

sentences.en: You knit me together in my mother's womb.
sentences.zh: 你在我母腹中塑造了我。

sentences.en: And you'll hear that cited in Christian anti-abortion spaces a lot as evidence that
sentences.zh: 你会在基督教反堕胎的语境中经常听到这句话被引用，作为

sentences.en: God cares about and views as fully human, human beings at the very moment of conception.
sentences.zh: 上帝关心并在生命的最初时刻将人类视为完全人类的证据。

sentences.en: And that would include these frozen embryos.
sentences.zh: 这自然也包括这些冷冻胚胎。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: If you truly believe that life begins at conception, you probably would not agree to abortion at any stage of gestation.
sentences.zh: 如果你坚信生命始于受精，你大概就不会赞同任何孕育阶段的堕胎。

sentences.en: And that same logic would apply to IVF.
sentences.zh: 同样的逻辑也适用于试管婴儿。

sentences.en: So when this issue gets raised at the conference, what happens?
sentences.zh: 所以当这个问题在会议上被提出时，发生了什么？

sentences.en: What are people saying?
sentences.zh: 大家都在说什么？

sentences.en: So there's a resolution that comes to the floor.
sentences.zh: 会上提出了一项决议。

sentences.en: Resolutions in Southern Baptist language are non-binding.
sentences.zh: 用美南浸信会的话来说，决议是不具约束力的。

sentences.en: This would not be a ban.
sentences.zh: 这不会是一项禁令。

sentences.en: It's just a statement of concern that's meant to summarize Southern Baptist opinion on this particular topic.
sentences.zh: 它只是一份关切声明，旨在总结美南浸信会对此特定话题的看法。

sentences.en: So the language that's proposed calls on Southern Baptists to reaffirm the value of human life.
sentences.zh: 因此，提议的措辞呼吁美南浸信会重申人类生命的价值。

sentences.en: And then it narrows in on human life in an embryonic stage.
sentences.zh: 然后它缩小范围，聚焦于胚胎阶段的人类生命。

sentences.en: And it urges them to just use reproductive technologies, fertility treatments that are consistent with that view of human life.
sentences.zh: 并敦促他们只使用符合这种人类生命观的生殖技术和生育治疗。

sentences.en: What does that mean?
sentences.zh: 那是什么意思？

sentences.en: They're actually walking a pretty fine line here.
sentences.zh: 他们在这里实际上走得非常微妙。

sentences.en: They stop short of saying that a Southern Baptist should never use IVF under any circumstances.
sentences.zh: 他们没有直接说美南浸信会信徒在任何情况下都绝对不能使用试管婴儿。

sentences.en: They're calling attention to these excess embryos and saying that, you know, Baptists really should only use reproductive technology with attention to life at this embryonic stage.
sentences.zh: 他们将人们的注意力引向这些多余的胚胎，并表示浸信会在使用生殖技术时，确实应该关注生命在这一胚胎阶段的尊严。

sentences.en: And the resolution also goes so far as to ask Baptists to call on their governments to restrain these kind of technologies that violate the dignity of, you know, as they put it,
sentences.zh: 该决议甚至还要求浸信会呼吁他们的政府限制这类违反，正如他们所说的，

sentences.en: quote, frozen embryonic human beings.
sentences.zh: 引述，“冷冻胚胎人类”尊严的技术。

sentences.en: So they're also actually asking people to pressure their governments to respect this position, basically.
sentences.zh: 所以他们实际上还要求人们向政府施压，以尊重这一立场，基本上是这样。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It's light on specifics, but that's the suggestion.
sentences.zh: 细节上很含糊，但这确实是他们的建议。

sentences.en: But, Ruth, why did they decide to raise this issue now?
sentences.zh: 但是，露丝，他们为什么决定现在提出这个问题？

sentences.en: I mean, IVF, obviously, has been around for a long time.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，试管婴儿显然已经存在很久了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So back in February,
sentences.zh: 所以在二月份的时候，

sentences.en: there was a case that reached the Alabama Supreme Court that had started when a group of families in the state filed this wrongful death claim over a mistake at a fertility clinic where their frozen embryos were accidentally destroyed.
sentences.zh: 阿拉巴马州最高法院审理了一起案件，起因是该州的一群家庭针对一家生育诊所的失误提起了不当死亡诉讼，他们的冷冻胚胎在那里被意外毁坏了。

sentences.en: They sue, and the state Supreme Court ends up ruling, not only in their favor, but says really clearly that frozen embryos should be considered children.
sentences.zh: 他们起诉了，而州最高法院最终不仅做出了有利于他们的裁决，而且非常明确地表示冷冻胚胎应该被视为儿童。

sentences.en: So the chief justice writes, even before birth, all human beings have the image of God and their lives cannot be destroyed without effacing his glory.
sentences.zh: 因此，首席大法官写道，甚至在出生之前，所有人类都拥有上帝的形像，他们的生命不容被毁坏，否则就是对上帝荣耀的玷污。

sentences.en: So really putting out this religious argument for human life in embryonic form.
sentences.zh: 这确实为胚胎形态的人类生命提出了强烈的宗教论据。

sentences.en: So that case lands like a bomb.
sentences.zh: 所以这个案件就像一颗炸弹落地。

sentences.en: The stunning decision from Alabama's Supreme Court has enormous and immediate consequences for fertility care.
sentences.zh: 阿拉巴马州最高法院令人震惊的裁决，对生育医疗护理产生了巨大且即时的后果。

sentences.en: And it really caught a lot of people off guard, you know, all along the spectrum.
sentences.zh: 它确实让光谱各个立场上的许多人感到措手不及。

sentences.en: A third fertility clinic in Alabama has shut down after the state Supreme Court ruled embryos are children.
sentences.zh: 在州最高法院裁定胚胎即儿童后，阿拉巴马州的第三家生育诊所已经关闭。

sentences.en: The court offered no clear roadmap for what is and isn't legal.
sentences.zh: 法院并未就什么是合法、什么是不合法提供清晰的路线图。

sentences.en: And it just places this question about the ethics and the legal aspects and all of this.
sentences.zh: 这引发了关于伦理、法律以及所有这些方面的疑问。

sentences.en: It just puts IVF into the national conversation.
sentences.zh: 它直接将试管婴儿推入了全国对话的中心。

sentences.en: We're concerned that with the new ruling, we may have to limit fertilization of eggs, which will limit success of treatment, limit efficiency, increase cost and, of course,
sentences.zh: 我们担心，随着新的裁决出炉，我们可能不得不限制卵子的受精，这将限制治疗的成功率、降低效率、增加成本，并且当然

sentences.en: risk to patients.
sentences.zh: 会增加患者的风险。

sentences.en: It's a stressful process already, and I don't need the added stress of, and no other woman does,
sentences.zh: 这本身已经是一个充满压力的过程了，我不需要再承受额外的压力，也没有其他女性需要承受

sentences.en: of whether or not this might be moral to go through to have children when this is my only path.
sentences.zh: 为了生孩子而经历这一切是否符合道德的压力，而这又是我的唯一途径。

sentences.en: And there's this really strong backlash to the idea that embryos should be protected with the force of the law as full human beings, because IVF is broadly popular,
sentences.zh: 人们对“应该以法律的强制力将胚胎作为完全人类加以保护”这一观点产生了强烈的反弹，因为试管婴儿在总体上非常受欢迎，

sentences.en: including among many Republican voters.
sentences.zh: 包括在许多共和党选民中也是如此。

sentences.en: Alabama House of Representatives and the Senate have passed a law that restores access to in vitro fertilization.
sentences.zh: 阿拉巴马州众议院和参议院通过了一项恢复试管婴儿获取渠道的法律。

sentences.en: Doctors at clinics have told ABC News the new language will give them enough reassurance to resume IVF without facing legal risks.
sentences.zh: 诊所医生告诉美国广播公司新闻网，新的措辞将给予他们足够的保证，以便在不面临法律风险的情况下恢复试管婴儿。

sentences.en: Ultimately, the state legislature, the Republican governor, you know, work really quickly to reinstate it in the state.
sentences.zh: 最终，州议会和共和党州长迅速采取行动，在该州恢复了这一程序。

sentences.en: But it opens up this new conversation among conservative evangelicals who are broadly anti-abortion.
sentences.zh: 但它在总体上反对堕胎的保守派福音派群体中开启了一场新的对话。

sentences.en: And they're starting to think, you know, should we think about this IVF conversation in the same way that we've thought about abortion?
sentences.zh: 他们开始思考，我们是否应该用看待堕胎的相同方式来思考试管婴儿的对话？

sentences.en: Should we be pushing on this more?
sentences.zh: 我们是否应该在这方面施加更多推动？

sentences.en: So most of the country takes the lesson from the Alabama case that IVF is not something to be interfered with.
sentences.zh: 因此，全国大部分地区从阿拉巴马州的案件中得到的教训是，不应该干涉试管婴儿。

sentences.en: But for some in the evangelical community, they take the opposite lesson, it sounds like.
sentences.zh: 但对于福音派社区的一些人来说，听起来他们得出了相反的教训。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: For some evangelicals, this feels like the perfect moment to bring IVF into the abortion conversation and start to turn the tide against it.
sentences.zh: 对某些福音派人士来说，这感觉像是将试管婴儿引入堕胎对话并开始扭转局势的绝佳时机。

sentences.en: One of these people is an ethicist in Kentucky.
sentences.zh: 其中一人是肯塔基州的一位伦理学家。

sentences.en: His name is Andrew Walker.
sentences.zh: 他的名字叫安德鲁·沃克。

sentences.en: He works at Southern Baptist Theological Seminary.
sentences.zh: 他在美南浸信会神学院工作。

sentences.en: It's a major Southern Baptist seminary in Louisville.
sentences.zh: 那是路易斯维尔的一所主要的美南浸信会神学院。

sentences.en: And he's been wanting to bring IVF into sort of the mainstream Southern Baptist consciousness for a while.
sentences.zh: 他一段时间以来一直想把试管婴儿引入美南浸信会的主流意识中。

sentences.en: He first started writing about it about five years ago.
sentences.zh: 他大约在五年前首次开始撰写相关文章。

sentences.en: He actually published an essay in a, you know, sort of mainstream evangelical publication about it, got a lot of pushback,
sentences.zh: 他甚至在一份主流福音派刊物上发表了一篇关于此事的文章，遭到了很多反对，

sentences.en: never felt it was the right moment to bring a resolution to the meeting.
sentences.zh: 他从未觉得将决议提交会议的时机已经成熟。

sentences.en: But he's had this tucked in the back of his mind because he has this pretty clear conviction that IVF does not comport with Christian anti-abortion values.
sentences.zh: 但他一直把这个想法藏在心底，因为他有着非常明确的信念，即试管婴儿不符合基督教反对堕胎的价值观。

sentences.en: So when the Alabama ruling happens and the backlash and the broader conversation, Andrew Walker thinks, you know, this is the moment.
sentences.zh: 因此，当阿拉巴马州的裁决发生以及引发反弹和更广泛的对话时，安德鲁·沃克认为，时机就是现在。

sentences.en: So he calls his friend and mentor, Dr. Al Mohler, who's the president of the seminary where they both work, and he says, let's do it.
sentences.zh: 于是他打电话给他的朋友和导师艾尔·莫勒博士，他是他们两人工作的那所神学院的院长，他说，我们干吧。

sentences.en: Let's start crafting a resolution for the meeting this year, and we'll see if it gets forward.
sentences.zh: 让我们开始为今年的会议起草一份决议，看看它能否被提交上去。

sentences.en: We'll see if it gets discussed.
sentences.zh: 看看它能否被讨论。

sentences.en: We'll see if it gets approved.
sentences.zh: 看看它能否被批准。

sentences.en: But we've got to strike while the iron is hot here.
sentences.zh: 但我们必须趁热打铁。

sentences.en: And did Baptists like Walker understand that a resolution like this would have potentially quite bad implications for mainstream Republican politicians?
sentences.zh: 像沃克这样的浸信会信徒是否明白，像这样的决议可能会给主流共和党政治家带来相当糟糕的影响？

sentences.en: Like, wasn't that the lesson of Alabama?
sentences.zh: 难道这不正是阿拉巴马州事件给人的教训吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And I talked with both Dr. Walker and Dr. Mohler about this, and they both said they were completely aware of that.
sentences.zh: 我和沃克博士以及莫勒博士都谈过这件事，他们都表示他们完全清楚这一点。

sentences.en: They didn't love it.
sentences.zh: 他们并不喜欢这样。

sentences.en: But they both felt that that was not their highest priority.
sentences.zh: 但他们都认为这不是他们最高优先级的事。

sentences.en: That was not their highest responsibility.
sentences.zh: 那不是他们最重要的责任。

sentences.en: And if anything, you know, Dr. Mohler said this in particular, he wanted to nudge Republicans on the issue.
sentences.zh: 如果说有什么不同的话，莫勒博士特别谈到，他想在这个问题上推动共和党人一把。

sentences.en: He actually said he wanted to do more than nudge Republicans.
sentences.zh: 他实际上说他想做的不仅仅是推动共和党人。

sentences.en: He wanted to call them out.
sentences.zh: 他想公开质问他们。

sentences.en: And so this would be a really high-profile way to show to Republicans, look, we've got thousands of mainstream Southern Baptists in a room here
sentences.zh: 因此，这将是一种备受瞩目的方式，向共和党人表明，看吧，我们这里有一千名主流美南浸信会信徒聚在一个房间里，

sentences.en: who are all expressing collective alarm and opposition to IVF as it's commonly practiced.
sentences.zh: 他们都对这种普遍实行的试管婴儿表达了共同的警惕和反对。

sentences.en: Okay, so Baptist leaders nevertheless put this proposal to a vote on the floor.
sentences.zh: 好的，尽管如此，浸信会领袖们还是将这项提案提交大会进行投票。

sentences.en: Tell us about how that went when they put this proposal in front of thousands of other evangelicals.
sentences.zh: 跟我们讲讲当他们把这份提案摆在数千名其他福音派信徒面前时情况如何。

sentences.en: It was really dramatic.
sentences.zh: 非常戏剧化。

sentences.en: We're in this cavernous convention hall where, over the course of the last few days, there's been singing of hymns.
sentences.zh: 我们身处这个巨大的会议大厅里，在过去几天里，大家一直在唱赞美诗。

sentences.en: People have heard sermons.
sentences.zh: 人们听了布道。

sentences.en: There's been prayers.
sentences.zh: 有祈祷活动。

sentences.en: They've sent missionaries out.
sentences.zh: 他们派遣了传教士出去。

sentences.en: You know, they've been sort of together in the work of making their convention what they want it to be.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们一起努力将他们的会议塑造他们想要的样子。

sentences.en: Microphone 3A, would you give us your name, your church, and proceed with your discussion?
sentences.zh: 3A号麦克风，请报上您的姓名、教堂名称，并开始您的讨论。

sentences.en: Yes, Daniel Taylor, messenger.
sentences.zh: 好的，丹尼尔·泰勒，信使。

sentences.en: And then there's this incredibly dramatic discussion and debate about the ethics of something so personal.
sentences.zh: 随后是一场关于如此私人的事情的伦理问题的极其戏剧化的讨论和辩论。

sentences.en: Thank you, Mr. President.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，主席先生。

sentences.en: I rise to speak in favor of this amendment out of both a heart for the unborn and for those stricken with infertility.
sentences.zh: 我起立发言支持这项修正案，既是为了未出生之人的胸怀，也是为了那些饱受不孕不育折磨的人。

sentences.en: Anyone is allowed to come to the microphone under Southern Baptist rules.
sentences.zh: 根据美南浸信会的规则，任何人都可以走到麦克风前发言。

sentences.en: And you had two men come to the microphone to share really personal stories.
sentences.zh: 你有两位男士走上麦克风分享了非常私人的故事。

sentences.en: For my friends, the initial steps of IVF yielded six viable embryos.
sentences.zh: 对于我的朋友们来说，试管婴儿的最初几个步骤产生了六个可存活的胚胎。

sentences.en: Four of the embryos were implanted and two were frozen for a time.
sentences.zh: 其中四个胚胎被植入，两个被冷冻了一段时间。

sentences.en: Only one survived to term, their son and my godson.
sentences.zh: 只有一个存活到足月，那是他们的儿子，也是我的教子。

sentences.en: Because of him, I thank God for IVF.
sentences.zh: 因为他，我感谢上帝赐予试管婴儿技术。

sentences.en: One has a godson born via IVF.
sentences.zh: 有人通过试管婴儿技术拥有了一个教子。

sentences.en: I have a son because of IVF.
sentences.zh: 因为试管婴儿，我才拥有了一个儿子。

sentences.en: I have another son 20 weeks old in my wife's womb because of IVF.
sentences.zh: 由于试管婴儿技术，我妻子腹中还有一个20周大的儿子。

sentences.en: The other has one child and his wife pregnant with a second via IVF.
sentences.zh: 另一个人有一个孩子，他的妻子通过试管婴儿怀上了第二个孩子。

sentences.en: I am for the sanctity of life and for the sanctity of embryos.
sentences.zh: 我支持生命的神圣性，也支持胚胎的神圣性。

sentences.en: I am against the idea that this technology is so wicked that it cannot be employed.
sentences.zh: 我反对那种认为这项技术如此邪恶以至于不能使用的观点。

sentences.en: And both spoke about just loving these children and seeing the technology as a blessing from God.
sentences.zh: 两人都谈到只是深爱这些孩子，并将这项技术视为上帝的赐福。

sentences.en: I thank the authors of the resolution and the committee for the opportunity for the SBC to be a voice of biblical truth and clarity in this pressing cultural issue.
sentences.zh: 我感谢该决议的起草人和委员会，让美南浸信会得以在这个紧迫的文化问题上发出符合圣经真理和清晰立场的声音。

sentences.en: A woman came to the microphone sort of on the other side.
sentences.zh: 有一位女士走到麦克风前，可以说是持相反立场的。

sentences.en: In addition to my living children, I am the mother of four babies that I never got to hold.
sentences.zh: 除了我活着的孩子之外，我还是四个我从未有机会抱一抱的孩子的母亲。

sentences.en: Two of those babies we adopted as embryos.
sentences.zh: 其中两个孩子是我们通过胚胎领养得到的。

sentences.en: Nothing in the process of IVF upholds the sanctity of life.
sentences.zh: 试管婴儿过程中的任何环节都无法维护生命的神圣性。

sentences.en: There is no way to describe the treatment of embryos at any point in the IVF process as ethical or dignified.
sentences.zh: 在试管婴儿过程的任何阶段，都无法将对胚胎的处理描述为符合伦理或有尊严的。

sentences.en: To share that she had participated in embryo adoption, meaning that she had another family's embryos implanted in her womb to try to bring those pregnancies to fruition.
sentences.zh: 分享她曾参与胚胎领养，这意味着她将另一个家庭的胚胎植入自己的子宫，以试图让这些妊娠结出硕果。

sentences.en: And in this case, she miscarried both times, but she had done that out of a sense of really moral obligation to these embryos as human life.
sentences.zh: 而在这种情况下，她两次都流产了，但她这样做是出于对这些胚胎作为人类生命的一种真正道德义务感。

sentences.en: And it was quiet.
sentences.zh: 现场一片寂静。

sentences.en: I mean, people are really listening to these really personal stories and wrestling with them.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，人们真的在倾听这些非常个人的故事，并在内心挣扎。

sentences.en: This is personal for a lot of people in that room.
sentences.zh: 对房间里的许多人来说，这是非常私人的事情。

sentences.en: But at the end of all this, it's time to vote on the resolution.
sentences.zh: 但这一切结束时，是时候对该决议进行表决了。

sentences.en: So in the end, the language has been really carefully crafted to kind of bring Southern Baptists along on this argument.
sentences.zh: 因此，最终，措辞经过了非常仔细的斟酌，以便在这一论点上引导美南浸信会信徒。

sentences.en: So it affirms that God loves all children, no matter the circumstances of their conception.
sentences.zh: 因此，它肯定了上帝爱所有的孩子，无论他们出生的背景如何。

sentences.en: It expresses empathy for couples trying to conceive.
sentences.zh: 它表达了对渴望生育的夫妇的同理心。

sentences.en: It says it's a good and positive thing to want to have children, to expand your family.
sentences.zh: 它指出，想要孩子、扩大你的家庭是一件美好且积极的事情。

sentences.en: And then it arrives at this point of saying that IVF, as it's commonly practiced, is not an ethical option for Southern Baptists in most circumstances.
sentences.zh: 接着，它得出结论认为，试管婴儿在普遍的操作方式下，在大多数情况下对于美南浸信会信徒来说并不是一个符合伦理的选择。

sentences.en: So this resolution comes to a vote to the thousands of people in that room.
sentences.zh: 于是，这项决议交由房间里的数千人进行表决。

sentences.en: They're all sitting in folding chairs.
sentences.zh: 他们都坐在折叠椅上。

sentences.en: They raise their little orange ballots in favor or againSt.
sentences.zh: 他们举起手中代表赞成或反对的小橙色选票。

sentences.en: And the resolution passes overwhelmingly.
sentences.zh: 该决议以压倒性多数获得通过。

sentences.en: So this resolution ultimately passes.
sentences.zh: 因此，这项决议最终通过了。

sentences.en: But how important is it really if it's just, you know, an expression of sentiment?
sentences.zh: 但如果这只是一种，你知道的，情感的表达，它到底有多大意义呢？

sentences.en: It's not actually a directive to do something.
sentences.zh: 它实际上并不是采取某种行动的指令。

sentences.en: It's hugely significant.
sentences.zh: 这意义重大。

sentences.en: This is the first major public statement that this group of influential evangelicals, frankly, influential Republican voters have made on this issue.
sentences.zh: 坦率地说，这是这群有影响力的福音派基督徒，也就是有影响力的共和党选民，就这个问题发表的第一份重大公开声明。

sentences.en: And it really sets them up on a collision course with mainstream Republicans.
sentences.zh: 这确实让他们与主流共和党人走上了对立的冲突道路。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Wynna Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜·刘。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我编写“字海无涯”（Connections）游戏，这是《纽约时报》游戏板块的谜题之一。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢试图捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖尔斯基。

sentences.en: And I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我每天都创作“拼写蜜蜂”（Spelling Bee）和“连字框”（Letterboxd）游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做色听觉的现象。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 当我听音乐时我能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由真人制作的。

sentences.en: Like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 就像你刚才听到声音的那些人一样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com 斜杠 games，今天就开始游玩。

sentences.en: So, Ruth, you said that this vote really sets evangelicals on a collision course with mainstream Republicans.
sentences.zh: 那么，露丝，你提到这次投票确实让福音派基督徒与主流共和党人走上了冲突之路。

sentences.en: What did that look like?
sentences.zh: 那是个什么情况？

sentences.en: So, mainstream Republicans in the wake of the Alabama ruling have really circled the wagons to try to show that they are not only totally comfortable with IVF,
sentences.zh: 因此，在阿拉巴马州裁决之后，主流共和党人确实紧密抱团，试图表明他们不仅完全不排斥试管婴儿，

sentences.en: but are going to go to great lengths to preserve it.
sentences.zh: 而且将竭尽全力去保护它。

sentences.en: And they see it as pro-family.
sentences.zh: 他们认为这是亲家庭的。

sentences.en: They know that's how most of their constituents view it.
sentences.zh: 他们知道大多数选民都是这样看的。

sentences.en: They want to really show that they see that as totally separate from the conversation about abortion and that they are going to be the ones to preserve access to IVF.
sentences.zh: 他们极力想表明，他们认为这与堕胎的讨论完全无关，并且他们将成为维护试管婴儿获取渠道的推手。

sentences.en: And so, on the very same day this happened in Indianapolis, in Washington...
sentences.zh: 因此，就在印第安纳州发生这一切的同一天，在华盛顿……

sentences.en: I want to yield to the senator from Alabama, Senator Britt.
sentences.zh: 我想把发言权让给来自阿拉巴马州的参议员布里特参议员。

sentences.en: Thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: Senator Katie Britt of Alabama, she's an evangelical Christian.
sentences.zh: 阿拉巴马州的凯蒂·布里特参议员，她是一名福音派基督徒。

sentences.en: She gets up on the floor of the Senate and gives this impassioned speech supporting IVF.
sentences.zh: 她走上参议院发言台，发表了这篇支持试管婴儿的激昂演讲。

sentences.en: I was proud to join my colleague from Texas and introducing the IVF Protection Act.
sentences.zh: 我很荣幸能与我来自德克萨斯州的同僚一起引入《保护试管婴儿法案》。

sentences.en: She, with Senator Ted Cruz of Texas, has put forward this bill that they say is intended to protect IVF access by blocking Medicaid funding to states that ban it outright.
sentences.zh: 她与来自德克萨斯州的参议员特德·克鲁兹共同推出了这项法案，他们表示，该法案旨在通过切断对彻底禁止试管婴儿的州的医疗补助资金来保护试管婴儿的获取渠道。

sentences.en: Democrats say that actually would not have done anything to fix the problem, and there are these kind of jockeying bills.
sentences.zh: 民主党人表示，这实际上无助于解决问题，并且存在这些形式各异的竞争法案。

sentences.en: But still, she gets up on the Senate floor.
sentences.zh: 但即便如此，她还是走上了参议院发言台。

sentences.en: Okay, as a mom, I know firsthand that there's no greater joy in this life than that of being a mother.
sentences.zh: 好吧，作为一个母亲，我亲身体会到，生命中没有什么比身为人母更大的喜悦了。

sentences.en: IVF helps aspiring parents...
sentences.zh: 试管婴儿帮助渴望成为父母的人……

sentences.en: And speaks, you know, as a mom, as she puts it, in defense of IVF.
sentences.zh: 并且，正如她所说，她以母亲的身份发表讲话，为试管婴儿辩护。

sentences.en: IVF access is fundamentally pro-family.
sentences.zh: 试管婴儿的获取渠道从根本上说是亲家庭的。

sentences.en: She's wearing this really prominent cross necklace, and, you know, she talks about how supporting IVF is pro-family, that that's the pro-family point of view.
sentences.zh: 她戴着一条非常醒目的十字架项链，你知道的，她谈到支持试管婴儿是亲家庭的，这才是亲家庭的观点。

sentences.en: We all have loved ones, whether they're family members or friends, who have become parents or grandparents through IVF.
sentences.zh: 我们都有亲人，无论是家庭成员还是朋友，他们通过试管婴儿成为了父母或祖父母。

sentences.en: And she puts out a statement the same day with Senator Cruz, and it's signed by all of her Republican colleagues, including Josh Hawley, Marsha Blackburn, you know,
sentences.zh: 她在同一天与克鲁兹参议员发表了一份声明，并由她所有的共和党同僚签署，其中包括乔什·霍利、玛莎·布莱克本，你知道的，

sentences.en: every conservative across the spectrum in the Senate signs onto this support for IVF.
sentences.zh: 参议院中跨全谱的每一位保守派都在这份支持试管婴儿的文件上签了名。

sentences.en: So even the most conservative Republicans in Congress are coming out with this position that's really at odds with evangelicals.
sentences.zh: 因此，即使是国会中最保守的共和党人，也表露出了这种与福音派格格不入的立场。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: IVF is hugely popular.
sentences.zh: 试管婴儿非常受欢迎。

sentences.en: Fertility treatments are widely used, you know, including by evangelicals.
sentences.zh: 生育治疗被广泛使用，你知道的，其中也包括福音派基督徒。

sentences.en: Most people don't even think negatively about this stuff, let alone want to ban it.
sentences.zh: 大多数人甚至对这些东西没有任何负面看法，更谈不上想要禁止它了。

sentences.en: So it's a real dilemma for Republicans to watch evangelicals potentially turn in this direction.
sentences.zh: 因此，对于共和党人来说，看着福音派可能朝这个方向转变，真是一个真正的两难境地。

sentences.en: So there's pressure from the Southern Baptist Convention on mainstream Republicans, which I have to imagine is making Democrats pretty happy.
sentences.zh: 因此，美南浸信会对主流共和党人施加了压力，我想这一定让民主党人相当高兴。

sentences.en: I mean, I saw President Biden out there with a fundraising email the day that the Southern Baptists voted.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，在美南浸信会投票的那天，我看到拜登总统发出了筹款邮件。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I mean, Democrats are really leaning into reproductive rights right now.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，民主党人现在确实在极力倾向于生殖权利。

sentences.en: They're putting abortion measures on ballots in November.
sentences.zh: 他们正在将堕胎议题列入11月的选票中。

sentences.en: They know that's going to attract their voters.
sentences.zh: 他们知道这会吸引他们的选民。

sentences.en: It's going to attract independents.
sentences.zh: 这将吸引独立选民。

sentences.en: They're pointing out these restrictions.
sentences.zh: 他们正在指出这些限制措施。

sentences.en: They're talking about this stuff.
sentences.zh: 他们在谈论这些事情。

sentences.en: From the Southern Baptists is another suggestion that there's this movement out there that doesn't just want to regulate at 15 weeks, not just at 12 weeks, not just at six weeks,
sentences.zh: 来自美南浸信会的又一个迹象表明，外面存在着这样一场运动，它不仅想在15周时进行监管，不仅在12周时，不仅在6周时，

sentences.en: but, you know, all the way down to the embryo in the lab.
sentences.zh: 而是，你知道的，一直延伸到实验室里的胚胎。

sentences.en: So I think Democrats see an opportunity here to exploit this growing divide between evangelicals and Republicans, at least on this issue.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为民主党人在这里看到了一个机会，可以利用福音派和共和党人之间日益扩大的分歧，至少在这个问题上是这样。

sentences.en: And this is all going to be all the more salient ahead of a very important presidential election.
sentences.zh: 在非常关键的总统大选即将来临之际，这一切将变得更加引人注目。

sentences.en: I mean, we're really hurtling down the tracks toward a big decision point for people.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们确实正在向人们的一个重大决策点全速前进。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 是的，完全正确。

sentences.en: The Republican Party and American evangelicals have been in lockstep, really, since the 1970s.
sentences.zh: 实际上，自20世纪70年代以来，共和党和美国福音派一直保持着高度一致。

sentences.en: And, you know, now for Republicans,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，现在对共和党人来说，

sentences.en: there's this question about whether or not it's still politically advantageous for them to follow where the anti-abortion movement is going on this stuff because they're pushing into places that are really deeply unpopular among the American population overall.
sentences.zh: 存在这样一个问题：顺应反堕胎运动在这些事情上的发展方向，对他们来说是否仍然在政治上有利，因为他们正在推进一些在美国民众总体中极不受欢迎的领域。

sentences.en: And, you know, the anti-abortion movement itself at this point is pretty divided on where it's going to go next.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，反堕胎运动本身在这一点上也对下一步该走向何方存在相当大的分歧。

sentences.en: So, you know, we saw the Supreme Court last week on Thursday, you know, they maintained access to the abortion pill.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，我们看到最高法院上周四，你知道，他们维持了对堕胎药的获取渠道。

sentences.en: You know, there were divisions even within the anti-abortion movement over whether or not to bring that case forward.
sentences.zh: 你知道，甚至在反堕胎运动内部，对于是否要推进该案件也存在分歧。

sentences.en: Some within that movement were skeptical of it.
sentences.zh: 该运动中的一些人对此持怀疑态度。

sentences.en: So you're seeing sort of confusion and disagreement even internally on where to go after the overturning of Roe v.
sentences.zh: 所以你可以看到，即使在内部，对于在推翻罗诉韦德案之后该走向何方，也存在着某种混乱和分歧。

sentences.en: Wade.
sentences.zh: 韦德案。

sentences.en: Ruth, what about the broader population of evangelical Christians?
sentences.zh: 露丝，更广泛的福音派基督徒群体情况如何？

sentences.en: You know, there were 10,000 people at the Southern Baptist Conference voting on this.
sentences.zh: 你知道，有1万人参加了美南浸信会会议并对此进行投票。

sentences.en: But what about everybody else?
sentences.zh: 但其他人呢？

sentences.en: Where are they on this?
sentences.zh: 他们在这个问题上持什么立场？

sentences.en: I think that's still a really open question at this point.
sentences.zh: 我认为目前这仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。

sentences.en: You know, I talked to this young pastor from Georgia at the meeting who was saying, you know,
sentences.zh: 你知道，我在会上和佐治亚州的一位年轻牧师交谈过，他说，你知道，

sentences.en: I don't want to go back to the people in my church and tell them that the creation of their children and grandchildren comes from these immoral means.
sentences.zh: 我不想回到我教会的人群中去告诉他们，他们的孩子和孙辈的创造是通过这些不道德的手段进行的。

sentences.en: And the language of the resolution was careful around that, but it's still going to be really hard to get that across and to just translate it for the people in the pews.
sentences.zh: 该决议的措辞对此很谨慎，但要向教堂长椅上坐着的普通信徒传达并向他们解释这一点仍然非常困难。

sentences.en: And if you're an ordinary Southern Baptist, kind of reading the headlines and even reading the text of this, it's a tough one.
sentences.zh: 如果你是一个普通的南方浸信会信徒，读着头条新闻甚至阅读这篇文本，这确实是个难题。

sentences.en: At the same time, you know, talking with Andrew Walker about this, who co-wrote the resolution, you know,
sentences.zh: 与此同时，你知道，与安德鲁·沃克讨论这个问题时，他是该决议的共同起草人，你知道，

sentences.en: he acknowledged that a lot of Southern Baptists have not really thought about this stuff in terms of ethics and morality and connected it to the abortion question.
sentences.zh: 他承认许多美南浸信会信徒并没有真正从伦理和道德的角度考虑过这些事情，也没有将其与堕胎问题联系起来。

sentences.en: But when he has one-on-one conversations with people about the topic and sort of walks them through basically the logic of the resolution, you know,
sentences.zh: 但是，当他与人们就这个话题进行一对一的对话，并基本上带领他们梳理决议的逻辑时，你知道，

sentences.en: he said almost everyone comes away from those conversations with, at the very least, a sort of skepticism and, you know,
sentences.zh: 他说几乎每个人在这些对话结束后，至少都会带着一种怀疑态度，并且，你知道，

sentences.en: a level of critical thinking around fertility treatments that they didn't come in with.
sentences.zh: 对他们原本不具备的生育治疗产生了一定程度的批判性思考。

sentences.en: And that suggests that there's at least sort of an openness to thinking differently about fertility treatments.
sentences.zh: 这表明，人们至少对以不同方式看待生育治疗抱有一定的开放态度。

sentences.en: And, you know, the reason all this matters is, obviously, evangelicals are this hugely influential voting bloc.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，这一切之所以重要，显然是因为福音派是一个具有巨大影响力的投票集团。

sentences.en: They're used to having the power to turn their theological beliefs into policy.
sentences.zh: 他们习惯于拥有将他们的神学信仰转化为政策的力量。

sentences.en: And when they come together, you get this political force, you know,
sentences.zh: 当他们凝聚在一起时，你就会得到这种政治力量，你知道，

sentences.en: the same political force that worked for decades over a lot of obstacles and was eventually successful in overturning Roe v.
sentences.zh: 同样的政治力量在几十年的时间里克服了许多障碍，最终成功推翻了罗诉韦德案。

sentences.en: Wade.
sentences.zh: 韦德案。

sentences.en: Now, IVF is different than abortion.
sentences.zh: 现在，试管婴儿与堕胎不同。

sentences.en: IVF is extremely popular, including, at this point, among evangelical Christians.
sentences.zh: 试管婴儿极其受欢迎，包括在这一点上的福音派基督徒中也是如此。

sentences.en: But if we find out that evangelicals are persuadable on IVF, you know, it doesn't just have implications for their personal spiritual lives.
sentences.zh: 但如果我们发现福音派对试管婴儿是可以被说服的，你知道，这不仅对他们的个人精神生活有影响。

sentences.en: If this is the beginning of a moral awakening on IVF, and that's a big if, it would have real implications for the rest of the country.
sentences.zh: 如果这是针对试管婴儿的道德觉醒的开始（这是一个很大的假设），它将对全国其他地方产生真正的深远影响。

sentences.en: Ruth, thank you.
sentences.zh: 露丝，谢谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: On Friday, the Supreme Court struck down a ban on bump stocks, which enable semi-automatic rifles to fire at speeds rivaling those of machine guns.
sentences.zh: 周五，最高法院推翻了对撞火器的禁令，撞火器能使半自动步枪以堪比机枪的速度进行射击。

sentences.en: The decision, by a vote of 6-3, split along ideological lines, had the effect of erasing one of the government's rare firearm regulations that came from a mass shooting.
sentences.zh: 这项6比3的裁决沿着意识形态阵营分裂，其结果是抹去了政府为数不多的源于大规模枪击事件的枪支法规之一。

sentences.en: Justice Clarence Thomas, writing for the majority, said that the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco,
sentences.zh: 大法官克拉伦斯·托马斯在为多数派撰写的意见书中表示，酒精、烟草、

sentences.en: Firearms and Explosives had exceeded its power when it prohibited the device by issuing a rule that classified bump stocks as machine guns.
sentences.zh: 火器和爆炸物管理局在发布将撞火器归类为机枪的规定时，禁止该装置的行为已经超出了其权力范围。

sentences.en: And tens of thousands.
sentences.zh: 数以万计的民众。

sentences.en: And tens of thousands of demonstrators crowded onto streets in France on Saturday to denounce the rise of the country's far right as the nation prepared to vote in snap elections set to take place later this month.
sentences.zh: 周六，数以万计的示威者涌入法国街头，谴责该国极右翼势力的崛起，当时该国正准备在定于本月晚些时候举行的突发选举中投票。

sentences.en: French President Emmanuel Macron shocked the country last week by announcing that he was dissolving the lower house of parliament after his party was clobbered by far right opponents in a vote to seat the next European parliament.
sentences.zh: 法国总统马克龙上周宣布解散国民议会下议院，此前他的政党在欧洲议会选举中遭到极右翼对手的痛击，此举震惊了全国。

sentences.en: Critics, including some in Macron's own party,
sentences.zh: 批评人士，包括马克龙自己党内的一些人，

sentences.en: warned that the president's move to call snap elections opened the door to empowering the far right in France for the first time since World War II.
sentences.zh: 警告称，总统提前举行大选的举动为自二战以来首次让极右翼在法国掌权打开了大门。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Rob Zipko, Sydney Harper, Stella Tan, Astha Chaturvedi, and Rochelle Bonja.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由罗布·齐普科、悉尼·哈珀、斯特拉·谭、阿斯塔·查图维迪和罗谢尔·邦贾制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by Mark George and Lisa Chow, contains original music by Dan Powell and Marion Lozano, and was engineered by Alyssa Moxley.
sentences.zh: 由马克·乔治和丽莎·周剪辑，包含丹·鲍威尔和马里昂·洛扎诺的原创音乐，并由艾丽莎·莫克斯利进行工程制作。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Lansford of Wonderly.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由来自 Wonderly 的吉姆·布伦伯格和本·兰斯福德创作。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Sabrina Tavernisi.
sentences.zh: 我是萨布丽娜·塔维尼西。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》中，我们正在为假期招待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目获取让您的客人在家中感到宾至如归的秘诀。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是需要完全黑暗才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they black out to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否会晕厥过去睡觉。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们需要什么样的光线条件？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为那是一个非常具体的要求。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症吗，对食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶的人？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on The New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用或您喜欢的任何收听平台上查找《The Wirecutter Show》。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有什么过敏症或食物禁忌吗？
